render_site_findings.problem: Placeholder-initial: the first-letter rule in ur-latin-initial-sites.test.ts drops {name} so it cannot see this. With a Latin computer name the paragraph base resolves LTR (first strong char). Derived visual order (UBA, LTR base): "Studio Mac ںیرک جرد ڈرو ساپ اک" — an Urdu reader reads «کا پاس ورڈ درج کریں» first and the name last, the D2 class; heading ragged to the wrong edge. RTL base gives the correct order.
render_site_findings.fix: Spread {...composedDir} (useComposedDir, already in scope at own-tunnel.tsx:93) onto that Text; add the key to the test as a placeholder-initial site (own list), since the catalogue value is correct and must not change. Pre-existing same-class value (not this slice): added.connected_to «{name} سے منسلک ہو گیا۔».

render_site_findings.problem: Literal scheme followed by Urdu: the "://" neutrals sit between L ("http") and R (Urdu) and take the RTL paragraph direction (UBA N1/N2), so the token renders "//:http" / "//:https" (derived with a minimal UBA pass: insecure_allow -> "//:http ہداس", unencrypted_body -> "//:https یئوک"). Brief notes require these schemes "unchanged and left-to-right". No ur value at 59ec5184 contains "://", so this is new with S2a.
render_site_findings.fix: Isolate the scheme as an LTR island at the render site (nested Text with LTR_WRITING / web unicode-bidi isolate), per docs/i18n.md "needs explicit isolation at the component"; no bidi controls in the catalogue (ur style guide). Android ignores writingDirection — needs a device frame.

render_site_findings.problem: Figtree (all 3 weights) has 0 Arabic-script glyphs (cmap parsed: 392 codepoints), so Urdu falls back to a system face. Unshaped isolated-form advance sums at 28 dp −0.02 em: set_up 242 (Geeza/Nastaliq UI) – 291 (SF Arabic) – 353/376 (Noto Nastaliq Urdu reg/bold) vs 227 budget; list 114–184 vs 138. Not measured on a device.
render_site_findings.fix: No copy change recommended (wording is natural and glossary-consistent with paths.own_title). Measure the title per locale (or stack on measured overflow) and take a ur device frame. Shorter fallback only if engineering declines: «کمپیوٹر جوڑیں» (est 152–274 dp) — weaker meaning.
